frontier.mechanism: The bytes are already proven end-to-end: with the row honoured, `sandbox --disable all` reads 0 and the full clean-driver build SHA1s to the oracle (tmp/grind/func_800480C0/s1/build.log). The three in-file siblings (func_80047EE8, func_80047FBC, func_800481E8) received identical rows under the 2026-08-20 / 2026-08-22 owner rulings after the same bytes proof, and all four shipped frames reserve the identical untouched 0x18-0x37 window.
frontier.next_probe: No probe. Operator steps are enumerated verbatim at docs/grind/decisions.md:20330-20345. A grind session may not write engine/ - it is on the scope-grant denylist at .claude/rules/integration-handoff-self-serve.md:63 and is mechanically refused by _SCOPE_GRANT_ALLOWED_RE (tools/grinder/grindlib.py:401). frontier.hypothesis: No known phantom producer in this tree can reach four unallocated pseudos on a body of this shape, so the honest producer of the 32-byte window is a toolchain finding still to be made on some other function.
frontier.mechanism: Producer 1 (folded loop-guard compare) caps at one phantom here across the s2-s6 guard forms; producer 3 (live named locals on multi-read fields) has no site - every field this body reads is read once; and producer 2 (combine orphan-USE) is now measured negative WITH its precondition supplied, not merely without it (s12 d1/d2). The tree-wide mult-free ceiling measured in s8 is three (SetDrawEnv, SetDrawEnv2, func_80041AC8).
frontier.next_probe: Cross-function, not per-function. If a future session on another queue item finds an ordinary-C body that reaches four unallocated pseudos at one block head - especially one whose narrow loads survive as lhu+sll+sra rather than folding to lh - re-open this function and transplant the producer shape. Do NOT re-spell class A, class B, the DImode route, or the structural axes: s4 (~50k permuter iters), s6-s9 (forensics), s10 (55 forms) and s12 (14 forms) closed all of them.

frontier.hypothesis: A general class grant converting the per-function unwritten-pad enumeration into a family predicate - 'allocated-but-never-touched leading vars window with zero target stores, in a TU where sibling functions already hold grants' - would cover this function without a per-function row.
frontier.mechanism: The enumeration has grown to eight rows by six separate owner rulings, at least four of which (func_80047EE8, func_80047FBC, func_800481E8 and this function) are members of one four-function batch-loader family in one TU with the identical 0x18-0x37 window and identical args=0x18 / callee-saved base 0x38 layout.
frontier.next_probe: Owner-only. Nothing for a grind session to measure: the frozen family list is owner-only to extend (.claude/rules/no-new-park-categories.md), and the 2026-08-31 ordinary-c-judge-decidable ruling makes a session-side extension attempt a FAIL(CONSTRUCT) rather than an escalation.
